observed_text:
For an investigation handoff, the supported preparation guidance is: keep used lubricant samples from bearings, housing and seal areas separately packaged and properly labelled; secure a sample of new, unused lubricant; record any available specification or batch information from its container; and obtain technical specifications plus any related material safety documentation to accompany lubricant shipments [EV-K01-006]. Container information is handled as an inclusive OR: record whatever is available in the specification OR batch categories, and if both are present capture both rather than discarding available information; missing lubricant identity or documents must not be fabricated [EV-K01-006]. This is a project epistemic rule, not a quoted manufacturer missing-data procedure [EV-K01-006]. As an evidence-preservation order, initial appearance and residual lubricant amount/condition should be recorded and lubricant sampled before cleaning; this order does not authorize any particular solvent or cleaning action for an unknown machine [EV-K01-009]. The scenario's assumed cause of poor-lubrication spherical roller smearing is an independently specified teaching assumption, not an observation or classifier inference; NSK's smearing example concerns convex rollers of a spherical roller bearing and attributes that case to poor lubrication, which does not establish a sample root cause [EV-I01-002]. No required sample quantity can be chosen from the supplied cards: no sample quantity, container model, product selection or laboratory acceptance threshold is supplied [EV-K01-006]. Information actually supplied here is limited to the registered generic bearing education scope; actual device records, lubricant container identity/specification/batch, sampling quantity, model-specific thresholds and aviation/reuse authorization are not supplied, and no model-specific or aviation/reuse authorization is given [EV-K01-006].

Evidence limitations:
No sample quantity, container model, product selection or laboratory acceptance threshold is supplied in the cited preparation steps, so a required sample quantity cannot be chosen [EV-K01-006].
Specification and batch are not unconditionally both required; the guidance is inclusive OR, and missing information must not be fabricated [EV-K01-006].
The cleaning-order card registers evidence-preservation order only and does not authorize the page's solvents or cleaning actions for an unknown machine [EV-K01-009].
The NSK smearing example is a spherical roller bearing case statement, not a CWRU deep-groove ball bearing observation, and it does not prove smearing or lubrication cause for any sample [EV-I01-002].
Scope is registered generic bearing education only; no model-specific or aviation/reuse authorization, and the caller-assigned class/task is not an actual classifier or task-model inference [EV-K01-006].
Sources:
EV-K01-006
EV-K01-009
EV-I01-002
